title: Why is my job pending? One answer per layer
purpose: Create the two situations that make a job wait (no fleet quota at the hub, no room in any worker) and show that each is explained by a different layer, in one line.

steps.display: kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # vision/too-big-for-fleet: queue cpu, 7 pod(s) x cpu 1
kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # llm/too-big-for-any-worker: queue cpu, 6 pod(s) x cpu 1
scripts/fleet-status.py workloads   # every workload in the fleet, and the layer holding it
steps.output:
CLUSTER  NAMESPACE WORKLOAD                           STATE
hub      llm       job-too-big-for-any-worker-bd12c   LAYER 1 pending: quota reserved at the hub, waiting for a worker to admit. No worker cluster reserved quota: cpu-a (ExceedsMaxQuota): couldn't assign flavors to pod 
hub      vision    job-too-big-for-fleet-4a048        LAYER 1 pending: no fleet quota. couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient quota for cpu in flavor fleet-cpu, previously considered
cpu-a    llm       job-too-big-for-any-worker-bd12c   LAYER 2 pending: couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient quota for cpu in flavor cpu-ondemand, previously considered podset
cpu-b    llm       job-too-big-for-any-worker-bd12c   LAYER 2 pending: couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient quota for cpu in flavor cpu-spot, previously considered podsets re

checks.description: the job larger than the team's fleet-wide quota waits at LAYER 1 (hub quota)
checks.because: The hub's ClusterQueue for the team caps the team at its fleet share plus what it may borrow.

checks.description: the job larger than any worker's queue waits at LAYER 1, with quota reserved and no worker admitting it
checks.because: The hub's quota allows it, so it is offered to the workers, and none of them has a queue big enough.

checks.description: the same job is waiting at LAYER 2 in the workers it was offered to
checks.because: Each worker's own Kueue holds the copy and says why it cannot admit it.

checks.description: neither job has created a single pod
checks.because: Admission comes before placement. Pods do not exist for work that has no quota.
